goal: Compose the delivered catalog and interface kit into functional capability-first application routes with session-owned preferences and minimal integration proof.
authority: User explicitly invoked $run add-capability-directory; proposal preparation confirms the activated scope.

do_not: Edit catalog DTO/repository/schema/migrations or reusable component implementation
Edit auth internals, add passkeys, or remove demo auth flows
Implement health probing, operator System behavior, storage, SSO, or Pi infrastructure
Use unvalidated query input as an external URL
Fold, push, or create a worktree

acceptance.command: bunx vitest run --project server src/lib/server/directory && bunx playwright test e2e/capability-directory.spec.ts
criteria: Home, capability/application indexes, and detail routes use the delivered shared components
GET query state is bounded, shareable, and visibility-safe
Preference writes derive owner from App.Locals and repository eligibility checks
External launches come only from catalog DTO approved URLs
Focused server tests and one minimal deterministic discovery E2E pass
